Adjacency.description: The `Adjacency` class represents the adjoining of the end of a sequence with the beginning of an adjacent sequence, potentially with an intervening linker sequence.

Allele.description: The state of a molecule at a Location.

CisPhasedBlock.description: An ordered set of co-occurring variants on the same molecule.

CopyNumberChange.description: An assessment of the copy number of a Location within a system (e.g. genome, cell, etc.) relative to a baseline ploidy.

CopyNumberCount.description: The absolute count of discrete copies of a Location within a system (e.g. genome, cell, etc.).

DerivativeMolecule.description: A molecule derived from segments of multiple adjoined molecular sequences, typically resulting from structural variation.

Expression.description: Representation of a variation by a specified nomenclature or syntax for a Variation object. Common examples of expressions for the description of molecular variation include the HGVS and ISCN nomenclatures.

Ga4ghIdentifiableObject.description: An object for which a GA4GH computed identifier can be created.

LengthExpression.description: A sequence expressed only by its length.

LiteralSequenceExpression.description: An explicit expression of a Sequence.

Location.description: A contiguous segment of a biological sequence.

MolecularVariation.description: A variation on a contiguous molecule.

Range.description: An inclusive range of values bounded by one or more integers.

ReferenceLengthExpression.description: An expression of a sequence that is derived from repeating a subsequence of an associated SequenceLocation.

RelativeAllele.description: An Allele defined on a mapped location relative to a base location. Often used to describe intronic variants.

RelativeSequenceLocation.description: A location on a base sequence and its position relative to a boundary offset on a mapped sequence gap. Typically used to describe intronic locations that exist with respect to a mapped RNA transcript sequence.

SequenceLocation.description: A Location defined by an interval on a SequenceReference.

SequenceOffsetLocation.description: A location defined by an offset relative to an anchor on a mapped sequence reference.

SequenceReference.description: A sequence of nucleic or amino acid character codes.

SystemicVariation.description: A Variation of multiple molecules in the context of a system, e.g. a genome, sample, or homologous chromosomes.

Terminus.description: The `Terminus` data class provides a structure for describing the end (terminus) of a molecule. Structurally similar to Adjacency, but used for describing where a molecule terminates (instead of adjoining another molecule).

TraversalBlock.description: A component used to describe the orientation of applicable molecular variation within a DerivativeMolecule.

Variation.description: A representation of the state of one or more biomolecules.

residue.description: A character representing a specific residue (i.e., molecular species) or groupings of these ("ambiguity codes"), using [one-letter IUPAC abbreviations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Union_of_Pure_and_Applied_Chemistry#Amino_acid_and_nucleotide_base_codes) for nucleic acids and amino acids.

sequenceString.description: A character string of residues that represents a biological sequence using the conventional sequence order (5’-to-3’ for nucleic acid sequences, and amino-to-carboxyl for amino acid sequences). IUPAC ambiguity codes are permitted in Sequence Strings.

release_notes:
Version 2.1.1 moves VRS to the renamed GKM metaschema processor (`ga4gh.gkm.metaschema`) and its abstract-class convention, and tracks GKM Core 1.3.0. The abstract classes `Variation`, `MolecularVariation`, `SystemicVariation`, `Location`, and `SequenceExpression` are now declared *sealed*: the processor derives each class's closed set of concrete subclasses instead of relying on hand-maintained `oneOf` lists. The derived sets match 2.1.0 exactly, so the instances VRS accepts and their computed identifiers are unchanged. This release also renames the "Concepts" documentation section to "Model", aligns the maturity model page with the GA4GH TASC [Technical Specification Development](https://www.ga4gh.org/document/tasc-technical-specification-development/) policy, and substantially expands the test suite.

## Patch Version Increment

- Adopts the renamed `ga4gh.gkm.metaschema` processor (`0.4.8`) and its abstract-class convention: abstract classes are marked `abstract: true` and left open, while concrete classes stay closed to undefined properties (`additionalProperties`/`unevaluatedProperties: false`), as they already were in 2.1.0, by @larrybabb in #718
- Declares `Variation`, `MolecularVariation`, `SystemicVariation`, `Location`, and `SequenceExpression` `sealed: true`, replacing their hand-written `oneOf` unions with processor-derived ones. The derived unions are identical to 2.1.0's. Properties that previously inlined a `oneOf` over the sequence expression classes (`Allele.state`, `RelativeAllele.baseState`/`mappedState`, `Adjacency.linker`) now reference `SequenceExpression` instead, which resolves to the same three classes, by @larrybabb in #718
- Publishes `Ga4ghIdentifiableObject` as a standalone, open JSON Schema (`json/Ga4ghIdentifiableObject`) by @larrybabb in #718
- Bumps the gkm-core submodule from `1.2.0` to `1.3.0`. The only data-model changes in GKM Core 1.3.0 are a new optional `ConceptSet.conceptSetType` field and `iriReference` as a new allowed `ConceptSet.concepts` member, and no VRS class uses `ConceptSet`. VRS classes that inherit from GKM Core's `Entity` (`Ga4ghIdentifiableObject`, `SequenceExpression`, `SequenceOffsetLocation`, `TraversalBlock`) or `Element` (`Expression`) see no property changes, since 1.3.0 only marks those root classes abstract, by @larrybabb in #718
- Retokenizes the schema identity (`$id`) to `2.1.1` by @ahwagner in #718, with a final retokenization pass (also dropping the ballot suffix from the gkm-core namespace pin) by @korikuzma when the release was cut
- Aligns the maturity model page with the GA4GH TASC [Technical Specification Development](https://www.ga4gh.org/document/tasc-technical-specification-development/) policy by @ahwagner in #714
- Renames the "Concepts" documentation section to "Model", generates the imported GKM Core class definitions locally instead of linking them from the submodule, and fixes the maturity model link, by @larrybabb in #718
- Expands the test suite with schema-invariant tests (abstract classes open, concrete classes closed), negative examples (`examples/invalid/`), concrete-class coverage for every instantiable VRS class, and `$ref` version-token resolution tests. Also regenerates the stale `validation/json/models.json`, adding the missing fixtures for the draft intronic-position classes, by @larrybabb in #718
- Updates the pre-commit CI job to check out submodules and install the schema-build dependencies, and makes the `update-json-def-files` hook fail on a `make` error, by @larrybabb in #718
- References the GA4GH metaschema processor in the README and refreshes contributor guidance (`.claude/CLAUDE.md`), by @larrybabb in #718

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ga4gh/vrs/compare/2.1.0...2.1.1
